timing_boundaries.t0_process_start: Runtime server process (llama-research-v2) launched for this run.
timing_boundaries.t1_model_ready: Model weights fully resident and server reports ready-to-serve (health/readiness signal). Model load time = t1 - t0; EXCLUDED from all decode-throughput and latency metrics below.
timing_boundaries.t2_request_sent: Generation request issued to the server for this run's fixed prompt.
timing_boundaries.t3_first_token: First decode token emitted by the server. TTFT = t3 - t2 (includes prompt/prefill processing).
timing_boundaries.t4_last_token: Final (n_predict-th) decode token emitted. End-to-end time to final token = t4 - t2. Total decode time = t4 - t3.

primary_metric.definition: n_decode_tokens / total_decode_time, where total_decode_time = t4 - t3 (steady-state decode window only). n_decode_tokens = n_predict - 1 (the token at t3 is the first decode token measured; the interval t3->t4 covers the remaining n_predict-1 token emissions) -- exact counting rule must match whatever argine's own step/decode-phase accounting already uses (argine.research.trace.PHASE_DECODE / counted_step), reused unmodified from R2-09A/R2-11, not redefined here.
primary_metric.aggregation_rule: Per (workload,budget,policy): mean over the 5 repetitions (warmup discarded). Primary aggregate: equal-weight mean of the per-workload mean across the 4 corpus workloads at the primary 4 GiB budget. No token-count weighting.

secondary_metrics.definition: Total bytes read from the expert store during the decode window (t3->t4), from the runtime's own expert-store I/O counters.
Total expert-store read operations during the decode window.
Bytes corresponding to expert-store cache misses during the decode window (same accounting family as R2-11's miss_bytes_per_decode_step, but measured on the real runtime's own counters, not replay).
OS-level page-cache hit/miss or read-ahead counters where the OS/runtime exposes them; recorded best-effort, never assumed if unavailable.
secondary_metrics.availability: best-effort; direct_io=1 is required (see machine_state_contract.json), which minimizes OS page-cache involvement in expert-store reads specifically.

secondary_metrics.definition: Process CPU time (user+system) consumed during t0->t4, from the OS process accounting for the runtime process.
t4 - t0 (full run including model load).
Peak resident set size of the runtime process over t0->t4.
secondary_metrics.note: Must not exceed the configured expert-store budget plus a fixed fixed overhead allowance for weights/runtime/KV-cache (see argine.planner); a violation is a memory-correctness failure, not a runtime result.

secondary_metrics.definition: Count of expert-store resident-byte budget violations detected during the run (must be zero; non-zero is a correctness failure per decision_rules.json, not a scientific throughput result).

CPU time attributable to the DecayedTransitionPredictor's per-layer predict()/update() calls, isolated via instrumentation (see instrumentation_contract.json); measured for PredictedProtectPolicy runs only (B_selected has no predictor).
CPU time attributable to the retention policy's own bookkeeping (victim selection, aging, score updates), isolated via instrumentation; measured for both policies for a fair comparison.

counting_rule_reuse: Decode-step counting and phase semantics reuse argine.research.trace.PHASE_DECODE and the counted_step()/served_steps() helpers used unmodified throughout R2-09A/R2-10/R2-11, so the R2-12 runtime token count is directly comparable to the R2-11 replay-based decode-step count for the same workload.
